qualification.details: A Medical qualification included in the first or second schedule or Part-II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (person possessing qualifications included in the part-II of the third schedule should also fulfill the conditions specified in Section 13 (3) of the Act). Must be registered with the Central/State Medical Council. A postgraduate qualification of an Indian University or MD (General Medicine) or its equivalent degree recognized as such by the Medical Council of India. Candidates who have completed 3 years tenure of Senior Residency and have done DM/M.Ch are not eligible.

content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the PGIMER Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: PGIMER Senior Resident (Adhoc) Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: A Medical qualification included in the first or second schedule or Part-II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (person possessing qualifications included in the part-II of the third schedule should also fulfill the conditions specified in Section 13 (3) of the Act). Must be registered with the Central/State Medical Council. A postgraduate qualification of an Indian University or MD (General Medicine) or its equivalent degree recognized as such by the Medical Council of India. Candidates who have completed 3 years tenure of Senior Residency and have done DM/M.Ch are not eligible.

content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years. Age Relaxation: SC/ST: 5 years OBC: 3 years Persons with Disability: 10 years (additional 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates)

content_sections.heading: PGIMER Senior Resident (Adhoc) Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Senior Resident (Adhoc) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on 31 August 2026 with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Senior Resident (Adhoc) posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Senior Resident (Adhoc) posts announced by PGIMER.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Medical qualification included in the first or second schedule or Part-II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, and a postgraduate qualification from an Indian University or its equivalent.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the Senior Resident (Adhoc) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 45 years, with relaxations applicable for SC/ST, OBC, and Persons with Disability candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the PGIMER Senior Resident (Adhoc) recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification released by PGIMER for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident (Adhoc) posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on a walk-in interview conducted by the Postgraduate Institute of Medical Education and Research.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for the Senior Resident (Adhoc) position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Senior Resident (Adhoc) position is temporary.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attend the walk-in interview at the PGIMER office in Chandigarh. The exact venue details are usually provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry original certificates/testimonials, one set of Bio-data, photocopies of certificates, and a latest coloured photograph.

faq.question: Q10. Are candidates who have completed 3 years of Senior Residency eligible?
faq.answer: No, candidates who have completed 3 years tenure of Senior Residency and have done DM/M.Ch are not eligible for this adhoc position.
